name: audit-serve-error-visibility
title: Make serve error plane observable by default
description: Make the amc serve error plane observable by default. Route every unhandled 500 boundary (do_GET/do_POST/_handle_mutating_method), the MCP internal-error path, and the background continuous-generation/OTEL arms through a single operator error sink (type, message, capped traceback tail) while keeping client bodies generic; give _handle_mutating_method a catch-all boundary; and make /readyz a real two-dimension readiness check (declared artifacts present AND generation thread healthy). Audit items A-071..A-074 and A-076 (PR A). A-075 refusal counters and A-077 request-id join key remain as PR B follow-up on this task.
